On the [purple]Atlas[/purple] screen, you will pick which dream to enter next.
At a [purple]Draft[/purple] site you build your deck by repeatedly selecting one of four cards to add.
You can [yellow]purge[/yellow] cards here, removing them from your deck for an ◆ essence cost.
A [purple]Dreamsign[/purple] is a persistent artifact of the dream that gives ongoing benefits.
Before each dream battle, you can view cards from your opponent's deck and see the ⍟ required to win
For this battle, the opponent's avatar ability is active and you must score 25⍟ to win
During your [purple]Dusk[/purple] phase, the opposing player may reposition their characters.
During your [purple]Night[/purple] phase, you can play ❖ fast cards and activate ❖ fast abilities
There are no valid targets for this card
If there is a tie in spark (✦) values, both characters in the challenge are dissolved
Cards can be [yellow]transfigured[/yellow] to change their cost, spark, or abilities
A character with [yellow]support[/yellow] gives a bonus to the two characters in front of it.
To [yellow]foresee[/yellow] 1, look at the top card of your deck. You may put it into your void.
A ▸Dissolved ability triggers when the character is sent to the void.
To [yellow]discover[/yellow] a card, reveal 3 matching cards from your deck and pick one to draw.
[yellow]Erode[/yellow] means to put cards from a deck into the void.
Figments are token representations of characters which can be merged together.
To [yellow]banish[/yellow] a card, remove it from the game. It does not go to the void.
To [yellow]dissolve[/yellow] a character, send it to its controller’s void.
[yellow]Prevent[/yellow] stops a card on the stack before it resolves, then sends it to the void.
To [yellow]rematerialize[/yellow] a character, trigger its ▸Materialized ability again while it stays in play.
An [yellow]ephemeral[/yellow] card left in your hand at end of turn is banished.
An [yellow]awakened[/yellow] character can challenge and use ☾ abilities on the turn it enters play.
When a [yellow]phasing[/yellow] character is played, you may return one of your characters to your hand and put this one in its position.
If an opposing effect would dissolve a character with [yellow]veil[/yellow], remove its veil instead.
[yellow]Reclaim[/yellow] lets you play this card from your void for its Reclaim cost, and then banish it when it leaves play.
[yellow]Offering[/yellow] lets you play this card for 0● by banishing a card from your hand. If you do, banish it at end of turn.
When a [yellow]vengeful[/yellow] character loses a challenge, it dissolves the opposing character too.
Every oath adds another voice: cheap warriors gather quickly, then grow mighty in one another's company.
A disciplined line shifts, shields, and supports its neighbors until even the humblest recruit can hold the horizon.
No warrior is lost to the dark for long; the fallen return, carrying each defeat into the next charge.
